svg.title: Power Up, Bots! — project card
svg.desc: A maths picture book that opens like a real hardcover. After the story, rotate a laser and cut energy blocks into two equal halves to charge the bots. Built with Css 3D, Javascript, Voice-Over. Live demo. Banner: the book's real cover.
